definition_zh: 转移（目光）；防止；避免（灾祸）
definition_en: to turn something away, especially the eyes or the face; also, to prevent something bad from happening
core_image: 危局袭来之前，一只手把目光和灾祸一同拨开
scene: 司机猛打方向盘，事故擦身而过。Quick action averted a pileup on the bridge.
sceneCN: 这里 avert 指「防止、避免」（第 2 个义项：使灾祸不发生）；句意：果断的处置避免了桥上的连环追尾。

derivatives.zh: 厌恶；反感（avert 的名词同族）
厌恶的；不愿的（同族形容词）

senses.title: To turn the eyes or face away
senses.definition: to turn the eyes, gaze, or face away from something
senses.definitionCN: 把目光、视线或脸从某物上转开
senses.example: She averted her eyes during the accident scene.
senses.exampleCN: 事故场面出现时她移开了目光。
senses.why: The Latin root is literal here: ab, away, plus vertere, to turn.
senses.whyCN: 此处词根是字面的：ab「离开」+ vertere「转」。

senses.title: To prevent something bad
senses.definition: to stop an expected evil, harm, or crisis from happening
senses.definitionCN: 使预料中的灾祸、危害或危机不致发生
senses.example: Quiet diplomacy averted a trade war.
senses.exampleCN: 低调外交避免了一场贸易战。
senses.why: Turning the danger away extends the bodily motion to events.
senses.whyCN: 把危险「转」走，把身体动作延伸到了事件上。

senses.title: To deflect a course of events
senses.definition: to bend a process or trend off its path before it lands
senses.definitionCN: 在事态落定之前使其偏离原有轨道
senses.example: Reform averted the colony's slide into revolt.
senses.exampleCN: 改革使殖民地免于滑向叛乱。
senses.why: A trend is a moving thing; it too can be turned.
senses.whyCN: 趋势也是运动之物，同样可以被拨转。

senses.title: To ward off harm by ritual or custom
senses.definition: in traditional practice, to keep off evil through ritual means
senses.definitionCN: 传统习俗中通过仪式手段驱避灾厄
senses.example: Charms were nailed up to avert the evil eye.
senses.exampleCN: 人们钉上符咒以禳避邪眼。
senses.why: Before diplomacy there was magic: pushing evil aside with a gesture.
senses.whyCN: 在外交之前先是法术：用一个动作把邪祟推开。

senses.title: To divert resources or attention
senses.definition: to redirect money, effort, or attention elsewhere
senses.definitionCN: 把资金、精力或注意力引向别处
senses.example: The agency averted funds to the flooded provinces.
senses.exampleCN: 该机构把资金转拨给受涝省份。
senses.why: Whatever flows can be re-turned: water, cash, or care.
senses.whyCN: 凡流动之物皆可改道：水、资金、关怀皆然。

senses.title: To avoid by turning aside oneself
senses.definition: in older use, to step or lean aside to escape contact
senses.definitionCN: 旧式用法中侧身或俯身避开接触
senses.example: The fencer averted the thrust with a slip of the hip.
senses.exampleCN: 剑手侧髋一闪，避开了刺击。
senses.why: The earliest English sense kept the body at the center.
senses.whyCN: 最早的英语义保留着身体中心。

senses.title: Averted, as a gaze or disaster
senses.titleCN: （分词用法）被移开的；被避免的
senses.definition: in participial use, describing a gaze held aside or a disaster just missed
senses.definitionCN: 分词用法，形容移开的视线或险些酿成的灾祸
senses.example: The report called it a narrowly averted meltdown.
senses.exampleCN: 报告称那是一次险些酿成的熔毁，幸被避免。
senses.why: The participle freezes the instant of successful turning.
senses.whyCN: 分词定格了「成功拨转」的一瞬。

senses.title: Averting, as a habit of the eyes
senses.definition: the gerundial use, habitual eye-avoidance in social behavior
senses.definitionCN: 动名词用法，指社交中习惯性的目光回避
senses.example: Constant averting of the gaze read as guilt.
senses.exampleCN: 频频回避目光被解读为心虚。
senses.why: A single motion, repeated, becomes a readable sign.
senses.whyCN: 单一动作不断重复，便成了可被解读的信号。

intro.en: Avert comes from Latin avertere, to turn away, from ab, away from, plus vertere, to turn; English borrowed the verb around the start of the fifteenth century.
intro.cn: avert 出自拉丁语 avertere「使转开」，由 ab（离开）+ vertere（转）构成；英语约在 15 世纪初借入该动词。

items.en: The turn-root descends from the reconstructed stem wer-, to bend or turn.
items.cn: 「转」词根出自重构词干 wer-「弯、转」。

items.en: averted was a common verb: to turn anything away, eyes, blows, omens.
items.cn: averted 是常用动词：目光、打击、凶兆皆可转开。

items.en: Roman religion spoke of averting omens, a divina ritu, ritual turning of fate.
items.cn: 罗马宗教有「以仪式禳解征兆」之说。

items.en: Middle English first used avert for physically turning aside.
items.cn: 中古英语先以 avert 表身体上的闪避。

items.en: The preventive sense hardened: to avert war, to avert ruin.
items.cn: 17 世纪「防止」义定型：avert war、avert ruin。

items.en: Today the two live senses are averted eyes and averted disaster.
items.cn: 如今该词的两个活跃义项是移开的目光与避免的灾难。

note.en: Group one gathers the vertere family and the eternal averse-adverse trap; group two gathers words of preventing and turning.
note.cn: 第一组收 vertere 词族与 averse-adverse 之辨；第二组收防止、转向义场的词。

entries.definition: adjective, unfavorable; adverse conditions work against you.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，不利的；adverse conditions 指不利条件，勿与 avert 混写。

entries.definition: the adjective of the same family: feeling turned away from something.
entries.definitionCN: 同族形容词：对某事心存厌恶。

entries.definition: to turn upside down; shares vertere.
entries.definitionCN: 倒转；同享 vertere 词根。

entries.definition: to stop something from happening; broader and blander than avert.
entries.definitionCN: 阻止发生；比 avert 更宽泛平直。

entries.definition: to act first so the bad thing cannot start.
entries.definitionCN: 先发制人地阻止，抢在坏事发生之前。

entries.definition: to turn aside a blow, question, or course.
entries.definitionCN: 使打击、问题或进程偏转。

entries.definition: to redirect a flow of things or attention.
to move the body out of the way; informal and physical.
entries.definitionCN: 闪身躲避；口语且偏身体动作。

normalIntro.en: Read a-vert as away-turn: turn the eyes away, turn the disaster away.
normalIntro.cn: 把 a-vert 读作 away-turn：目光转走，灾难也转走。

normal.en: ab- away plus vert turn: the same vert as in reverse and convert.
normal.cn: ab- 离开 + vert 转：vert 与 reverse、convert 里的 vert 相同。

normal.en: avert one's eyes for the body sense; avert disaster for the event sense.
normal.cn: 身体义用 avert one's eyes，事件义用 avert disaster。

normal.en: Avert takes the danger as object, never the person as object.
normal.cn: avert 的宾语是危险本身，不是人。

normal.en: narrowly averted is the set news phrase for a near miss.
normal.cn: narrowly averted 是新闻固定说法：险些未能避免。

normal.en: Adverse is the adjective that got the d; avert lost it.
normal.cn: 带 d 的是形容词 adverse；avert 没有那个 d。

abstract.en: See a hand press the tiller just before the reef.
abstract.cn: 想象触礁前一只手按住了舵。

abstract.en: Avert is a small word for turning fate at the last second.
abstract.cn: avert 这么小的词，却在最后一秒拨转了命运。

abstract.en: Feel the neck pivot before the eyes do.
abstract.cn: 感觉脖颈先于眼睛转了过去。

examples.en: The pilot averted catastrophe with a textbook landing.
examples.cn: 飞行员以教科书式的降落避免了空难。

examples.en: He averted his gaze from the accident on the roadside.
examples.cn: 他移开视线，不去看路边的车祸。

examples.en: Talks averted a nationwide rail strike at the last hour.
examples.cn: 谈判在最后一刻避免了全国铁路大罢工。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「恶我特」——那锅汤端过来他就喊「恶我特」，赶紧把脸特特地转开

root: 出自拉丁语 avertere「使转开」，由 ab-（离开）+ vertere（转）构成，属 vertere 大词族（reverse、convert、divert 等同源）。约 15 世纪初进入中古英语，先表身体闪避，17 世纪起「防止灾祸」义成为主导。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses turn on one motion: the eyes averted, the disaster averted, the funds redirected, and the ritual gestures that once did the same work.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一个动作展开：移开目光、拨开灾难、转拨资金，以及古时承担同样职能的禳解仪式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a firm hand turning eyes, then events, off their collision course.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手先把目光、再把事件从相撞的轨道上拨开。

branches.en: THE BODY SIDE: eyes, stances, and the habits they form.
branches.cn: 身体一面：目光、体态及其习惯。

branches.en: THE DISASTER SIDE: crises stopped and the participles that celebrate it.
branches.cn: 灾难一面：被阻止的危机及定格其成功的分词。

branches.en: THE TREND SIDE: histories bent before they break.
branches.cn: 趋势一面：在崩坏前被拨转的走向。

branches.en: THE RITUAL SIDE: charms and omens turned aside.
branches.cn: 仪式一面：被禳转的符咒与征兆。

branches.en: THE FLOW SIDE: money and attention given a new channel.
branches.cn: 流动一面：资金与注意力被引入新渠道。

intro.en: Avert is compact: prefix ab- plus stem vert, with no suffix left on the verb.
intro.cn: avert 结构紧凑：前缀 ab- 加词干 vert，动词本身不再带后缀。

latinIntro.en: The vertere stem generated dozens of English verbs and nouns through French -vert and -version forms.
latinIntro.cn: vertere 词干经法语 -vert、-version 形式繁衍出几十个英语动词和名词。
